# The Transformation's Aura Pressure boost: +500, or 250 + AP/8 at 2,000 AP and above.
ac_tf_ap_boost = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = ac_duel_tf }
		if = { limit = { ac_aura_pressure_value < 2000 } value = 500 }
		else = { value = ac_aura_pressure_value divide = 8 add = 250 round = yes }
	}
}
ac_duel_ap_value = { value = ac_aura_pressure_value add = ac_tf_ap_boost }
